metaTitle: Custom 12 oz Gift Boxes & Ribbons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 12 oz gift boxes and ribbons for your brand. Perfect for small gifts and corporate events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Our custom 12 oz gift boxes are designed for presenting small items like candles, soaps, or gourmet treats. The compact size makes them ideal for corporate gift sets, holiday favors, or employee appreciation packages. Pair them with matching ribbons in your brand colors for a polished, professional look. Choose from a variety of paper stocks and finishes, including matte or gloss lamination, to create a memorable unboxing experience.
heroAltText: Custom 12 oz gift boxes and ribbons with brand logo, perfect for corporate gifts
